title: Researcher's archive destroyed by his widow, part kept by his daughter

tellings.quote: and she herself says that her stepmother destroyed all the material and she still has a part of the material.

plain: After the death of a Brazilian researcher who had gathered material on a case from 1996, his widow is said to have destroyed his files, while his daughter, Claudia Kovu, kept part of them. Carlos de Souza, a surgeon interviewed on the podcast, passes on what Kovu herself says: "her stepmother destroyed all the material and she still has a part of the material." If so, some of the record of the case may still survive with her.
